description: This Dart source file implements the DashboardScreen widget for a Flutter-based attendance tracking app. It displays summaries of today's attendance, quick actions, and recent attendance marks, utilizing provider-based state management.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the dashboard overview with attendance summaries, quick actions, and recent attendance list.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing data fetching and UI state for DashboardScreen.

classes.name: _SummaryCard
classes.description: Reusable widget for displaying a section with a title, subtitle, icon, and content.

classes.name: _CounterPill
classes.description: Widget displaying a count within a styled pill, used for attendance status counts.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: Widget representing the status of an attendance item with color coding.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Lifecycle method to initiate data fetch once when dependencies change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the dashboard screen, including summaries and lists.

methods.name: _countStatus
methods.description: Counts the number of items with a specified status.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Generates a date string key in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format for accessing daily data.
